data.title: What the pattern can tell us
data.goal: What the pattern can tell us

memoryNodes.cue: One answer can mention different sorts of problem.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 一个回答可以提到不同种类的问题。

data.situation:
Dr Chen sat with them below the graph. There was variation between the two afternoons, but a few differences did not explain themselves. Maya thought there might be a correlation between the room’s temperature and the number of people who left early. Dr Chen asked whether they had enough information to say even that. A pattern in two sets of records could have several explanations. Jo: The questionnaire answers fall into three categories: light, space and furniture.
Maya: Some people mention more than one sort of problem.
Dr Chen: Then let the categories overlap where appropriate. Differentiate what visitors said from what you think caused it.
Jo: How should we evaluate the new arrangement?
Dr Chen: Include the visitors’ comments in your evaluation, and state the limits of this small project.

Maya thought there might be a correlation between the room’s temperature and the number of people who left early. Dr Chen asked whether they had enough information to say even that. A pattern in two sets of records could have several explanations.
readingBlocks.zh: 陈博士坐在图下和她们交谈。两个下午之间存在差异，但几处不同不会自己说明原因。玛雅觉得，室温与提前离开的人数之间可能有关联。陈博士问，资料是否连这点都足以说明。两组记录中的规律可能有多种解释。

Jo: The questionnaire answers fall into three categories: light, space and furniture.
Maya: Some people mention more than one sort of problem.

readingBlocks.zh:
乔：问卷回答分为三类：光线、空间和家具。
玛雅：有些人提到不止一种问题。
陈博士：那合适时就允许类别重叠。区分访客所说的话和你们认为的原因。
乔：应该怎样评估新安排？
陈博士：在评估中纳入访客评论，也说明这个小项目的局限。

glossary.zh: 数量、状况或程度上的差异；变化
glossary.note: variation in/between；本例观察差异，不是生物变种。
glossary.example: There was variation between the two afternoons.
glossary.exampleZh: 两个下午之间存在差异。

externalEvidence.definition: an instance of change; the rate or magnitude of change

glossary.zh: 两个变化量之间的相关关系
glossary.note: correlation between；相关本身不证明因果。
glossary.example: They asked whether there was a correlation between temperature and early departures.
glossary.exampleZh: 她们询问温度与提前离开之间是否相关。

externalEvidence.definition: a statistical relation between two or more variables such that systematic changes in the value of one variable are accompanied by systematic changes in the other

glossary.zh: 按共同特征划分的类别
glossary.example: The answers fall into three categories.

externalEvidence.definition: a collection of things sharing a common attribute

glossary.note: a sort of；本例名词，不是排序的动词。
glossary.example: Some visitors mentioned more than one sort of problem.
glossary.exampleZh: 有些访客提到不止一种问题。

externalEvidence.definition: a category of things distinguished by some common characteristic or quality

glossary.note: differentiate A from B / between A and B；不是微分运算。
glossary.example: Differentiate the comments from your own interpretation.
glossary.exampleZh: 区分评论和你自己的解释。

glossary.zh: 判断质量、作用或价值；评估
glossary.example: They evaluated the new seating arrangement.
glossary.exampleZh: 她们评估新的座位安排。

externalEvidence.definition: evaluate or estimate the nature, quality, ability, extent, or significance of

glossary.zh: 评估质量、作用或价值的过程
glossary.note: an evaluation of；与评价动词是不同词项。

externalEvidence.definition: act of ascertaining or fixing the value or worth of
